request.prompt: Input 1 is the current Buki landscape album screen and input 2 is the Buki golden bear reading a coral book brand icon. Redesign the full mobile UI into a polished modern kids scrapbook concept. Keep a compact Buki header and selector, one centered landscape one-page pad, and a floating camera button. The album must have a visible left-side ring binding, one large 16:9 artwork-safe frame, clear margins, a subtle 12-column alignment grid inside the page, chunky rounded corners, and playful but restrained corner pieces. Clay and Sky palette: terracotta coral #E96B54, sky blue #68B7E8, sunflower #F6C64A, navy #23435C, warm paper #FFF9EE, sand background #F5ECDD. Tactile premium stationery with soft clay details, child-friendly but sophisticated, feasible in Expo and Skia. No device frame, no extra writing, no gibberish text, no realistic room.
